sections.content: You know *para* + infinitive from A2 Unit 30, *para que* + subjunctive from B1 Unit 4, *con el fin de* + infinitive from B1 Unit 32, and the formal connectors *a fin de que*, *con el objeto de que*, *de modo que*, *con miras a* and *con vistas a* from B2 Unit 12. In negotiation drafts and settlement clauses, these connectors establish procedural safeguards and binding conditions. At C1, negotiation texts often pair negative purpose safeguards (*para que ninguna de las partes quede...*, *a fin de que no vuelva el litigio*) with prospective phrases (*con miras a la ratificación*, *con vistas al preacuerdo*), maintaining the usual split between same-subject commitments (infinitive) and cross-party guarantees (*que* + present or imperfect subjunctive).

sections.title: Safeguards and Prospective Purpose
rows: *para que / a fin de que / con el objeto de que* + subjunctive
Incluimos una cláusula para que el arreglo sea duradero. (We include a clause so that the settlement is lasting.)
Negative safeguard after a past verb (imperfect subjunctive)
Se redactó el texto a fin de que nadie volviera al litigio. (The text was drafted so that nobody would return to the lawsuit.)
*para / a fin de / con el fin de* + infinitive (same subject)
Firmamos de buena fe a fin de zanjar la disputa hoy. (We sign in good faith in order to settle the dispute today.)
*con miras a / con vistas a* + noun or infinitive
Alcanzaron un término medio con miras a ratificar el preacuerdo. (They reached a middle ground with a view to ratifying the pre-agreement.)

items.spanish: Se fijó un plazo amplio a fin de que las bases ratificaran el preacuerdo.
items.english: A generous deadline was set so that the rank and file could ratify the pre-agreement.

items.spanish: Redactaron la garantía con el objeto de que todos obraran de buena fe.
items.english: They drafted the guarantee so that everyone would act in good faith.

items.spanish: Las dos delegaciones cedieron con el fin de zanjar el litigio sin demora.
items.english: Both delegations compromised in order to settle the lawsuit without delay.

items.spanish: Buscaron un término medio con vistas al arreglo definitivo.
items.english: They sought a middle ground with a view to the final settlement.

sections.content: Even when a safeguard applies to 'both sides' including the speaker (first person plural → *las dos partes*), grammatically the subject changes to third person plural, so Spanish requires *que* + subjunctive: *Propusimos una pausa para que las dos partes revisaran el texto*, never an infinitive.
